permissions.name: draft:read
permissions.reason: See the words you type so a learned phrase can be offered as ghost text.

permissions.name: draft:read:full
permissions.reason: See an accepted ghost in the draft so it is not offered again.

permissions.name: draft:write
permissions.reason: Insert the visible ghost, or a menu-row fallback, as one undoable edit.

permissions.name: submit:observe
permissions.reason: Learn clauses only from a confirmed send, never from an unsent draft.

learn.description: Opt-in. Off until you set [phrases] learn = true.

ghost.description: Show ghost text. Codex stays off unless this is true and the host route is on.

skipWhenBusy.description: Do not show a ghost while the agent is busy.
